thread:
Ivy: Hey! Idea for Friday evening: "Build-Your-Own Sandwich" swap in the pantry at 6pm + a 10-question lightning trivia after. keep it quick and casual. :sandwich:
Noah: brilliant. i'll bring a loaf and a cutting board. are we doing labels for bread (gluten-free etc)?
Samir: i'll bring spreads + pickles. label wise: i'll do simple allergy sticks.
Becca: can i bring a quick quiz? 10 q's, 30s per question. prize: a fancy jar of hot sauce? :fire:
event-bot: Quick poll: react :one: to join the swap, :two: to join trivia only, :three: to watch/eat. Poll closes in 48h.
Ivy: sign-up sheet: tiny.rw/sandwich-swap - put what you'll bring and whether you want to be on a trivia team.
Noah: tiny logistics Q: is this BYO utensils? i'll bring a small stack of plates and 2 knives.
Samir: we should have a little stations: bread, proteins, spreads, toppings. volunteers to set up at 5:40?
Becca: i'll set up trivia slides and run them on my laptop. keep the mic optional.
Ivy: @Samir can you handle the allergy labels? and @Noah thanks for plates.
Samir: yep allergy labels done. i'll print vegan/contains-dairy/contains-nuts.
Noah: i'll bring a small box for composter scraps and a trash bag.
Becca: trivia theme: weird food laws + pop culture snacks. hope people know oddball facts.
Ivy: RSVP by Thursday noon so we know team sizes. also want to cap attendees at 30 to fit pantry.
event-bot: Reminder set for Thursday 10:00: "Sandwich swap RSVP cutoff"
Samir: small ask: if you're bringing something that needs refrigeration, flag it in the sheet.
Noah: will do. also can volunteers help tidy the pantry afterward? 15min teardown at 8pm.
Becca: i'm happy to coordinate teardown.
Ivy: perfect. last thing: if you want to enter your sandwich into a "most creative" mini contest, write the sandwich name on the sticker and we'll applause-judge. :tada:
Samir: "The Night Owl" incoming.
Noah: haha i'm bringing a simple turkey-avocado.
Becca: excited. see you Friday!
